description: Export the document (or a page_range) as PDF to path (the target file path – not output_path). Preset chain: preset (without it the localized built-in "High Quality Print" preset); when the result exceeds fallback_over_bytes it is exported again with fallback_preset (without both there is no second pass); a preset that does not exist falls back to the localized "High Quality Print" preset, then to the current export preferences, each with a warning. A spread preset turns single pages into spreads – check exported_page_count. The server configuration can hold default values for the three preset parameters; a parameter in the call always wins. page_range uses the printed page names as shown in InDesign ("6-8", "1, 3-5"; "+3" is the third page regardless of its name). Returns path, exported_page_count and document_page_count (page_count equals exported_page_count), bytes, preset_used and page_range_used. Pass fallback_over_bytes 0 or fallback_preset "" to disable the second pass. use_document_bleed true exports with the document bleed (Anschnitt, see set_document_bleed) for this call only, without changing the preset – needed for print-on-demand and any bleeding image, because built-in presets such as [PDF/X-1a:2001] export without bleed; false exports without bleed; omitted = as the preset says. Also returned: document_bleed_used (true/false, null if unknown) and document_bleed_mm {top, bottom, inside_or_left, outside_or_right}. InDesign writes anywhere on the machine, also outside shared folders. Can take minutes on a full issue.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

fallback_over_bytes.description: Size threshold in bytes for the second pass. Default: the configured value, otherwise 0 = no second pass.

fallback_preset.description: Preset for the second pass when the file exceeds fallback_over_bytes. Default: the configured preset, otherwise none. "" disables the second pass.

page_range.description: Pages to export, by printed page name, e.g. "6-8" or "1, 3-5". Default all.

path.description: Required. Target .pdf path on the machine running InDesign.

preset.description: PDF export preset name (exact, as listed in InDesign). Default: the configured preset, otherwise the localized "High Quality Print".

use_document_bleed.description: true: export with the document bleed (Anschnitt) for this call only, the preset stays unchanged; false: without bleed. Default: as the preset says.

name: export_pdf
title: Export as PDF
